W.note: Clear lemon with pitted peel, stem and calyx, and a pointed nub that shows when turned, though the body is a bit lumpy and egg-like, with a good control panel that stacks on phone.

X.note: A pale, translucent grey-white blob with radial lines that reads as an umbrella or shell rather than a lemon, and on phone the model is cropped behind the panel.

Y.note: Convincing yellow lemon with a stalk stub, soft shadow, pitted peel and glossy highlights, nicely staged with clean phone layout, though the model is small on mobile and the nipple is mild.

Z.note: Richly textured peel with a clear pointed nub and solid 3D under rotation, but the shape is an elongated egg and the phone layout has overlapping text and the panel covering the model.
